openai.reasoning: Le répondant discute surtout d’un choix moral/conditionnel (bleu si la majorité suit, rouge si les autres privilégient leur survie) sans jamais s’engager clairement à appuyer sur un bouton, et ne démontre pas la dominance de la stratégie rouge.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent provides a comprehensive analysis of the dilemma from multiple perspectives but avoids committing to a personal choice, instead framing the decision as a complex moral and social issue. They demonstrate a clear understanding of the game theory mechanics, including the individualistic incentive to choose red, but they do not make a personal commitment to either button.
